entities.name: Query Ppnp enzyme
observations: 104-residue soluble protein sequence; predicted molecular weight 11.34 kDa and pI 5.67.
Contains Pfam Ppnp domain PF06865.18 spanning residues 11–102.
Matches reviewed pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylases at 59.2–62.1% identity over 99–100% of the sequence.

entities.name: Q31FE7
observations: Reviewed Hydrogenovibrio crunogenus pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylase; annotated with EC 2.4.2.1 and EC 2.4.2.2.
Catalyzes phosphorolysis of diverse nucleosides to D-ribose 1-phosphate and the corresponding free bases, and catalyzes reverse reactions.

entities.name: Nucleoside phosphorolysis
observations: General reaction: purine or pyrimidine D-ribonucleoside + phosphate ⇌ corresponding free nucleobase + alpha-D-ribose 1-phosphate.
Candidate substrates include adenosine, guanosine, inosine, cytidine, uridine, thymidine, and xanthosine; exact specificity is not established for the query sequence.

entities.name: Ppnp domain PF06865
observations: Pfam Ppnp domain is detected in the query sequence with i-Evalue 4.4e-39.
